notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.

event.text: Call 911 now for your son. Fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed, plus unusual sleepiness, can mean a rapidly worsening bloodstream infection that needs emergency hospital care immediately. Do not wait to see if he improves or for a reply here. Stay with him and follow the dispatcher's instructions; tell them about the rash and his drowsiness.
